title: debug_replay seeds unmasked store entity ids against the masked replay half, voiding the learned heat loss
claim: On the owner's 2026-11-16 download, tools/replay/debug_replay.py:run_seeded seeds store documents whose entity-id leaves (8 leaves in 4 stores) name ids absent from the masked replay half, so the replayed coordinator voids house_heat_loss_scale and lower_floor_loss_ratio ('its zone sensor changed') and drops 42 learned heat-loss samples before its first cycle: the D15 timeline replay runs a house model the install does not have.
mechanism: The debugger bundle's replay half is written through replay_doc's mask (each configured entity becomes its role name or an e_<hash> id), while its stores section is the install's store documents verbatim. debug_replay.seed_stores writes those documents onto the stub disk unchanged; the coordinator's thermal-learning load compares the stored heat_loss_zone_entities with the replay entry's (masked) zone sensors, finds them different, and runs the one void path (_void_heat_loss_learners). The same mismatch leaves dhw_legionella.disinfection_owned and off_restore.armed naming ids the replay has no state for (the replay logs the owned disinfection switch as unreadable).

evidence.contention_note: box shared with other finder seats (two other debug_replay runs); counts are contention-immune

perturbation.change: --remap-zones: rewrite the seeded thermal_learning heat_loss_zone_entities to the replay entry's own ids for the same keys (what a mask-aware seed_stores would write)

metric_definition: Learners the production void path resets while debug_replay.run_seeded sets up from the bundle's stores and runs the window's first cycle.
phenomenon_property: Every entity id a store document seeded by debug_replay names resolves in the replay half it is replayed against (the same mask applied to both), so the replayed coordinator starts from the install's learned state.

null_control.note: the synthetic bundle's stores were written by the same replay, so ids agree and nothing is voided

proposed_fix_scope: tools/replay/debug_replay.py seed_stores: carry the replay half's id mapping (or re-derive it with replay_doc's mask) and rewrite every entity-id leaf of the seeded stores through it before writing them; or have custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/debugger.py write the stores section through the same mask. Pin with a debug_replay gate check over a bundle whose stores carry an unmasked zone id.
